text:
opsbot: :rotating_light: Pager: SEV-2 - elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts in eu-west-1. Error rate 5xx > 8% for the last 6m. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings. Potential customer impact: interactive latency/timeouts and failed calls. Traces sparse for these requests (sampling drop). Paging oncall: @maria.

maria: on it. can someone grab ingress logs and check nginx/gateway latency first? also any recent deploys to eu-west?

sam: checking deploys - no user-facing deploys in last hour. I see a surge in connection resets on gateway-backend-3 and high queue depth on the kvcache proxy. sending logs now.

kevin: I can patch temporary debug logging in the ingress layer to emit request-id and upstream status. we should also increase trace sampling for the impacted service to 100% for 10m to correlate. we need to be careful about log volume.

opsbot: logs attached (truncated):
```
2024-11-02T14:12:03Z gateway-3 ERROR upstream_timeout route=/v1/generate trace_id=null req_id=null status=504
2024-11-02T14:12:05Z gateway-3 WARN connection_reset peer=10.1.21.5
2024-11-02T14:12:06Z kvcache-proxy INFO evict key=ctx:abc123
```

maria: trace_id=null / req_id=null - that's the observability gap. our request-id propagation probably dropped on the internal proxy. luke? (sorry @luca) can your team confirm whether the proxy strips headers on retries?

luca: looking. kvcache proxy has a retry path that re-issues requests without the original x-request-id header in some edge cases (we've seen this in old versions). current image tag on kvcache-proxy in eu-west is v1.3.1.

jess: Customer impact notes: two enterprise customers reported timeouts hitting /v1/generate around 14:10 UTC. We should notify them we're investigating and that mitigations are in progress.

sam: I'm going to scale up gateway-backend-3 and move some traffic to gateway-1 (us-east) as a short-term mitigation. will also flip a routing policy for non-low-latency traffic.

kevin: patch for temporary instrumentation (will roll to a single canary pod first):
```
# middleware to log header context
def log_req(ctx):
    print(f"REQ {ctx.get('x-request-id', 'nil')} {ctx['path']} {ctx['method']} {ctx['status']}")
```
Applying now to ingress-canary-01. Also enabling trace sampling = 100% for service=ingress-eu-west for 15m via tracing API.

maria: +1 on canary. sam - confirm traffic shift and keep me posted on error rate. jess - draft short update to impacted customers with ETA for mitigation.

opsbot: deploy bot: ingress-canary-01 updated with debug-logs at 2365000250. tracing sampling set to 100% for service=ingress-eu-west until 2365001150.

sam: traffic shifted ~30% to gateway-1, scaled gateway-backend-3 replicas +3. error rate on /v1/generate dropped from 8.4% -> 3.2% over 6 minutes. still seeing intermittent 502s from kvcache-proxy.

kevin: while debug logs are live, I'm seeing requests with user-agent that triggers a retry path and the retry code path re-creates a fresh proxy request without copying x-request-id. attaching example log from canary:
```
REQ nil /v1/generate POST 502 upstream=kvcache-proxy retry=true
REQ 6b2f1a /v1/generate POST 200 upstream=kvcache-proxy retry=false
```

maria: root cause looks like header-drop in retry path of kvcache-proxy. short-term fix: modify retry to propagate x-request-id and increment trace sampling for kvcache-proxy. longer: ship a proper fix and add unit tests.

luca: I can push a hotfix to kvcache-proxy to forward headers on retry. prepping PR to target eu-west patch channel. will also add a lightweight metric that counts requests with missing request-id.

jess: customer update sent: "We're mitigating elevated errors by shifting traffic and enabling temporary telemetry. We're rolling a hotfix to an internal component and will follow with a post-incident report." :white_check_mark:

sam: after header propagation hotfix applied to kvcache-proxy-canary, traced requests now show request ids and correlation. error rate further down to 1.1%.

opsbot: monitoring alert: 5xx rate for /v1/generate in eu-west has returned to baseline (<=0.5%) as of 2365001300.

maria: great work. action items:
- luca: promote hotfix to eu-west cluster and monitor for unintended side effects (PR and rollback plan).
- kevin: open a follow-up to add integration tests for header propagation and a small circuit-breaker on retry volume.
- sam: autoscaling policy review for gateway-backend-3 to avoid slow ramp.
- jess: draft postmortem with customer impact timeline and communications.

luca: will promote hotfix now and watch logs.

kevin: created GH issue #4567 for test coverage and retry circuit-breaker.

jess: scheduling postmortem for tomorrow 15:00 UTC.

maria: closing pager. filing incident ticket and tagging relevant teams. thanks everyone. :heart:
